structured_output.summary: I removed the duplicated `.ui-start__label` block from src/ui/title.css and added its selector to the existing title-type rule in src/ui/screens.css, which is now `.ui-pause__title, .ui-start__label { … }`. The title type style is now defined in one place. start-screen.ts already imports screens.css, and no other rule targets `.ui-start__label`, so the SELECT TRACK heading gets exactly the same declarations as before and its behaviour and look are unchanged. Because this is a duplication finding, I added no new test. pnpm typecheck passes, and pnpm test passes: 111 files, 735 tests.
